issue.title: Mermaid diagram craft for the research swarm
issue.description: The research swarm's diagrams agent proposes fewer, better Mermaid figures. Each one answers a named reader question, reads on its own from figure, in-figure title, and caption, uses a small semantic palette, and passes a look at a PDF-settings render that prints at 75% scale or more. The craft lives in one shared `mermaid_diagrams` plugin skill. `#research/diagrams` inlines it, and the swarm lead loads it on demand.

payload.entry: LAND FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE (all three proposals from sase-1nd.2 reviewed using /sase_new_task): note #1 (quality evaluation after 5-10 swarms) corroborated ready task sase-1mo with +1 and added the early checkpoint, title/question, 80% full-size/75% floor, blind rating, omission, type-mix, runtime, version-cohort, and measured split criteria. Note #2 (optional deterministic lint) declined for now: explicitly conditional on a noisy look loop, with no post-change evidence of that condition; this would add speculative tooling beyond the approved epic. Note #3 (renderer parity / house theme) split by outcome: renderer-parity checker corroborated ready task sase-1mn with +1, explaining that mmdc replaced its historical vault-dependent producer and that actual-renderer parity is the remaining benefit; optional house theme declined pending measured quality need and a renderer-owner decision. Searched feature tasks across all statuses, swept the last week, broadened the lint/theme search to all task types, and reviewed active epic scopes (including sase-s5, which owns duplicate publication rather than diagram quality/parity). No new task or active-epic discovered-issue routing warranted. Preserve all these outcomes in the eventual close note.
